name: Nicholas Paine
profile: Robotics researcher from UT Austin's Human Centered Robotics Lab (Luis Sentis's lab) who co-founded Apptronik in 2016; the company's first project was work on NASA's Valkyrie humanoid. As CTO he leads hardware/controls for the Apollo general-purpose humanoid; Apptronik has raised $935M+ and is valued ~$5B.
interesting_fact: For Apollo, the team tested about 30 actuators to find the right one; Paine says he co-founded a general-purpose humanoid company partly because 'I was sick of seeing robots just dancing all the time.'
deep_cut_fact: Apptronik's first project was NASA's 300-pound Valkyrie humanoid; Paine explained in 2018 that robots must sense force and detect human contact to work safely near people, and that 'we try to be unconventional in the way we design things.'
notes: Technical co-founder; lower profile than CEO Jeff Cardenas. Route via Apptronik press.

name: Chen Zhihua
current_role: Party Secretary & Chairman, Kylinsoft (麒麟软件, China Electronics/CEC subsidiary) - if this is 谌志华
profile: Most likely 谌志华 (Chen/Shen Zhihua), Party Secretary and Chairman of Kylinsoft, the Tianjin-based CEC subsidiary behind the Kylin (银河麒麟) operating system, China's leading domestic desktop/server OS. Kylinsoft is a state-owned enterprise rather than a founder-led startup; general manager is Kong Jinzhu.
interesting_fact: Kylinsoft launched the openKylin open-source desktop OS community in 2022, and its Kylin OS was used in support of the Shenzhou-13 mission.
notes: Name match is via Kylinsoft newsroom (Nov 2026: 党委书记、董事长谌志华); Hurun 'founder' label doubtful for an SOE. Unlikely podcast guest.

name: Andrew Greene
profile: Defense software engineer (former contractor) who was part of the SpaceCAMP and Platform One teams Rob Slaughter assembled from 2018, then co-founded Defense Unicorns in March 2021. He focuses on evolving its Unified Defense Stack; the company was valued at over $1B after a $136M Series B led by Bain Capital in Jan 2026.
interesting_fact: Defense Unicorns' founding team helped Kessel Run achieve the DoD's first Continuous Authority to Operate (ATO) before building SpaceCAMP and Platform One.
notes: Low public profile. Media email from Oct 2024 release; confirm still active.
